column1: # renames.tsv (harbor#996 B1) — every path rename the standard orders, one row each: the codemod's only input.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. aliases.tsv holds TERMS (a word and the word to use instead), never paths
# (research 12e §3), so it cannot drive a rename. A rename here is a row plus one codemod run:
# `sh bin/standard-rename.sh --apply --id <id>` moves the file, rewrites every true reference to it,
# retires its exemptions.tsv rows and prints the residual list. The reviewer reads the rows; a
# conflict on main is a re-run on fresh main, never a hand merge. The research/03 rename TSV is not an
# input (12a §1): rows come from the mapping tables of harbor#961 through `--import`, or by hand.
# A ROW STAYS AFTER IT IS APPLIED, as the record that the old path is an alias of the new one. Whether
# it is applied is derived (old absent, new tracked), never written here. This file is the only place
# the codemod leaves an old name, so it is excluded from both the rewrite and the residual.
# standard_version: 2.0.0
# COLUMNS  id <TAB> old <TAB> new <TAB> surface <TAB> wave <TAB> remove_by <TAB> reason
#   id         rename-NNNN, unique, never reused
#   old, new   repo-relative paths of one tracked file; each appears in one row at most
#   surface    the lint-name.sh surface the new name is judged on (bin, path, env); the codemod refuses
#              a row whose new name has any finding. An env row names env:NAME twice and moves no file.
#              Other surfaces (launchd, check-id) are rows the codemod does not apply yet: it exits 3, unchecked.
#   wave       the harbor#961 wave label (W1 … W6b); --wave selects by it
#   remove_by  - (a plain rename). A date asks for the old name to keep working until then: a bin or path
#              row leaves a symlink at the old path (a bin/*.sh also gets a marked line in CONTRACTS/cli.md and CONTRACTS/idle-tools.txt),
#              an env row reads both names (the new, then the old).
#              Past the date the next --apply removes the shim or collapses the dual reads.
#   reason     why the new name, from the mapping row
